description: Defines classes and structures related to QUIC protocol acknowledgment frames, including PacketNumberQueue and QuicAckFrame, with methods for managing packet sequences and acknowledgment data.

classes.name: PacketNumberQueue
classes.description: Manages a sliding window of unique packet numbers, supporting addition, removal, and iteration over packet intervals.

classes.name: QuicAckFrame
classes.description: Represents an acknowledgment frame in QUIC, containing the largest acknowledged packet, timing info, received packet times, and ECN counters.
